intro.h2: Cabinets, bathrooms and the details in between
paragraphs: J&S Builds FL LLC does kitchen and bath remodeling in Palm Coast, FL, with a focus on careful installation. One customer bought his own cabinets and hired Jef and the team to put them in. He says the trim work was very good, the cabinets look excellent and the crew even cleaned up after themselves.

On the bathroom side, Lisa L. thanks Jef for a beautiful bathroom that is exactly what she wanted, and says using an extra bit of space in the room made the biggest difference. Another customer calls Jef pleasant, professional and quick to respond, and would have him back anytime.

items.name: Cabinet installation
items.blurb: Bought your cabinets already? We install them. One customer had us put in cabinets he purchased and says the trim work was very good and the cabinets look excellent. The kitchen shown here has raised-panel cherry cabinets with glass-front uppers, a granite island and a tumbled stone backsplash.

image.alt: Kitchen with raised-panel cherry cabinets, glass-front uppers, a granite island, stainless appliances and a tumbled stone backsplash

items.name: Kitchen updates
items.blurb: A kitchen refresh can change the whole first floor. This kitchen from our Google profile pairs white shaker cabinets that run up to the ceiling with a white quartz peninsula, a pull-down faucet and stainless appliances. Tell us what you want to change and we will plan it with you.

image.alt: White shaker cabinets reaching the ceiling around a white quartz peninsula with a pull-down faucet

items.name: Bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Good bathroom design is often about space. Lisa L. says the biggest difference in her new bathroom came from using extra space in the room, and that it turned out exactly as she wanted. We look at your layout the same way, searching for room you may not know you have.

items.name: Trim and finish work
items.blurb: The last inch is what people see. Mouldings, filler strips and panel ends decide whether cabinets look built in or simply set in place. One customer singled out our trim work in his review, and we treat that finishing as part of every installation rather than an afterthought.

why_choose_us.h2: Why Palm Coast homeowners recommend J&S

items.title: Trim work that shows
items.text: Paul M. says the trim work on the cabinets we installed for him was very good and that the finished cabinets look excellent. He says he would hire us again.

items.title: Polite and professional
items.text: Polite staff is one of the topics in our Google reviews. Customers describe Jef and the crew as polite, pleasant and professional from start to finish.

items.title: Quick to respond

about.text: J&S Builds FL LLC is a remodeling and handyman business in Palm Coast, Florida, and Jef leads the team on the job. Customers name him in every review, and our own replies to those reviews talk about helping homeowners build their dreams. The jobs reviewers describe include installing purchased kitchen cabinets with careful trim work and remodeling a bathroom to make better use of its space. Several customers say they would hire us again, and one can't wait for us to do the rest of her house. We are open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM.

process.h2: From first call to finished room

steps.title: Call us
steps.text: Call (386) 283-1277 between 9 AM and 6 PM on a weekday and tell us about the cabinets, kitchen or bathroom you have in mind.

steps.title: Schedule an estimate
steps.text: We set up a time for an estimate at your home, look at the space and talk through what you want it to become.

steps.title: Plan the details
steps.text: We go over layout, materials and the finishing details, including trim, so you can picture the finished room before work starts.

steps.title: Build and install
steps.text: Jef and the crew handle the installation with care for the trim and the small details, and keep you in the loop.

steps.title: Clean up and walk through
steps.text: We clean up after ourselves and walk the finished room with you to make sure it is what you wanted.

service_area.h2: Kitchen and bath remodeling in Palm Coast, FL
service_area.text: J&S Builds FL LLC works with homeowners in Palm Coast, Florida. If your home is close by and you want to be sure it is in our range, call (386) 283-1277 on a weekday between 9 AM and 6 PM. Let us know where you live and whether you are thinking about cabinets, a kitchen update or a bathroom, and we will tell you if we can take it on.

items.q: Can you install cabinets I already bought?
items.a: Yes. One customer purchased his cabinets and hired us to install them. He says Jef and the team did an excellent job, the trim work was very good and the cabinets look excellent. Have your cabinet order or layout handy when you call so we can talk through the install.

Yes. Lisa L. hired Jef for a bathroom remodel and says it is exactly what she wanted, with the use of extra space in the room making the biggest difference. Call us to talk about your bathroom, its current layout and what you would like to change.

items.q: How do I get an estimate?
items.a: Call (386) 283-1277 to schedule an estimate for your project. We will come out, see the space and talk with you about the work. You can also send a message through our Facebook page or the form on this page, along with a few photos of the room.

We are open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Customers say our response time is right on point, so if we miss your call, leave a message with your name and project and we will get back to you.

items.q: Are you a handyman service or a remodeler?
items.a: Google lists us under handyman services, and we take on home improvement jobs of different sizes. Most of the work our customers write about is bigger, though: installed kitchen cabinets with finished trim and a remodeled bathroom. Tell us about your project, large or small, and we will talk it through.

final_cta.h2: Ready to start your kitchen or bath?
final_cta.text: Call Jef and the J&S Builds crew to schedule an estimate.
